units.source_text: 我很有把握自己详细记下了他说的所有话。

en.t: I am quite sure that I wrote down everything he said in detail.

units.source_text: 假如有人看完我的笔记觉得不甚满意，那么请亲自去东京市外××村的S精神病院找疯子本人吧。

en.t: If anyone reads my notes and still feels dissatisfied, then please go in person to the S mental hospital in XX village outside Tokyo and ask the madman himself.

units.source_text: 面向显得很年轻的二十三号患者一定会尊敬的点头致意，让你坐在那把没有靠垫的椅子上。

en.t: The very young-looking Patient Number Twenty-three will surely nod to you respectfully and seat you in that chair without a cushion.

units.source_text: 接着，面带犹豫笑容的详细的把这个故事跟你再说一遍。

en.t: Then, wearing a hesitant smile, he will tell you this story once more in detail.

units.source_text: 最后——我还清晰的记得他跟我们讲完这个故事之后的脸色——

en.t: Finally, I still remember vividly the look on his face after he finished telling us this story.

units.source_text: 他刚站起来就抡起拳头，无论面对谁都恶语相向：

en.t: As soon as he stood up, he swung his fist and hurled abuse at everyone before him:

units.source_text: 你也是个愚蠢、多疑、色情、厚脸皮、傲慢、利己主义的出声！

en.t: You too are a stupid, suspicious, lecherous, shameless, arrogant, selfish wretch!
